name: io.github.nuthatch-org/nuthatch
title: nuthatch
description: Query an EVM contract's indexed history with SQL, via a local nuthatch nest and nuthatch dev.

runtimeArguments.name: --add-host
runtimeArguments.description: Docker Desktop (macOS, Windows) only. On Linux `nuthatch dev` listens on loopback, which the container cannot reach this way: run the container with `--network host` and set --url to http://127.0.0.1:8288 instead

packageArguments.name: --url
packageArguments.description: Base URL of the running `nuthatch dev` HTTP API; for a runtime hosting several nests, one mount of it (http://host:port/<alias>)

packageArguments.name: --token-env
packageArguments.description: Name of an environment variable in the container holding a bearer token, for a nest behind a gateway that wants one
